objective: A real local-model, three-round finite hypothesis/refinement campaign. Request two simple causal hypotheses per round; retain invalid, duplicate, rejected and failed attempts without refunds or retries. Later rounds inherit the previous round's first two evaluated proposal IDs and exact research feedback. Final selection is at most the first three numerically screen-admitted proposal IDs, with no winner ranking or formula edits. Use the unchanged model gate once if nonempty. All adaptive statistics are exploratory; no protected data or independent-alpha claim. This is a new bounded syntax-correction campaign after v1 produced two invalid case-sensitive field schemas and zero numerical evaluations. V1 remains frozen, consumes its recorded call and proposals, and is not reset or silently repaired.
